profile.headline: Founder & CEO of dishcourse.com. Technology leader. Software engineer for 30+ years.
profile.summary: I am looking for an opportunity that will spark my passion and allow me to contribute to a team that I think is genuinely making a difference.  An example would be a team involved in space exploration, but I am open to many other options.  I am most comfortable with full stack Java or Ruby on Rails development and I have been told that I have exceptional "soft skills" for an engineer.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Our mission is to make small business teams unstoppable. 

Homebase is the everything app for hourly teams, with employee scheduling, time clocks, payroll, team communication, and HR. 100,000+ small (but mighty) businesses rely on Homebase to make work radically easy and superpower their teams. 

Best Time Clock 2023 - The Motley Fool
Best Scheduling 2023 - Investopedia
Best HR & Employee App 2023 - The Webby Awards
Best employee communication tool ever! - Theresa Fouquette, Owner, Bliss Small Batch Creamery


Check out joinhomebase.com to see how Homebase can help you build an unstoppable team. 
In my role at Homebase, I’m part of the Distributions team, and I’m responsible for integrating homebase with other POS solutions.

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description: Chief. Everything. Officer. Check us out! https://dishcourse.com/about
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Lead Development · Ruby on Rails · Site Reliability Engineering · Organizational Development

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description: Technical lead on a back end server team responsible for the development and maintenance of seven microservices written in Ruby, Node, and Java.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Create and support API microservices in Ruby, Ruby on Rails, and Node. Work with devops teams to improve observability, maintainability, and stability of services, using ECS, Cloud Formation, Jenkins, and some in-house tools. Other tools used on a daily basis to solve problems include Redis, Postgresql, Elasticsearch, and CloudWatch.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Our mission is to create a world where work empowers a better life. 

We’re making the most complicated, impersonal business tasks simple and personal. Imagine payroll that brings everyone peace of mind, HR that transforms work into a community, and benefits that help people plan for a better future. That’s what we’re building at Gusto. 

To learn more about life at Gusto, visit gusto.com/careers. We’re hiring in San Francisco and Denver!

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Full stack Java developer.  Technology includes Java, Tomcat, Oracle, Spring, Hibernate, Spark
 - Helped scale the application to run on Apache Spark and Amazon Web Services (AWS)
 - Completed QlikView 11 Designer and QlikView 11 Developer certifications
 - Optimized QlikView analytics application to run ETLs 13x faster

positions.title: Tech Lead and Control Account Manager
positions.description:
- Managed $2.3 million of our project's total budget across two concurrent software development releases.
- Tech Lead for ~25 Java software developers across two concurrent software development releases
- Updated senior management on status during weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly program review boards

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: This is my official title within the company.  Please see my other entries for specific work experience.

positions.title: Engineering Leadership Development Program (ELDP)
positions.description:
Completed three one-year rotations (please see the following other entries for details):
- Java Software Developer
- Deputy Lab Manager / ABIR Integration Lead
- C++ Software Developer

- Received two consecutive SPOT awards for "Extensive Volunteer Support to ELDP"
- Completed Technical Development Curriculum (TDC) classes covering Defense and Space technologies including topics such as cyber security and orbital dynamics
- Capture Manager for TDC II project during the proposal phase
- Attended annual leadership development conferences

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented enhancements to a web-based Java EE (aka J2EE) planning and collaboration tool for the United States Strategic Command.
- I was the first software developer hired in Colorado Springs to help set up a team of 12 other developers and testers working remotely for the program which is based in Omaha, NE.
- Worked with the following technologies: Java EE, Spring, Hibernate, Eclipse, Oracle, jQuery, and CSS.

positions.title: C++ Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented software tools using C++ and Java
- Worked with SIGINT, COMINT, and ELINT systems
- Increased unit test coverage of my projects by 20%

positions.title: Deputy Lab Manager / ABIR Integration Lead
positions.locationName: Schriever Air Force Base, Colorado Springs, CO
positions.description:
- Deputy Lab Manager for the research and development component of a missile defense program.
- Lead the effort to integrate the Airborne Infrared (ABIR) prototype into the existing missile defense situational awareness software suite.
- Operated missile defense software during live missile flight test experiments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead an effort to design and implement a Linux security lockdown for the SSAFE project
- Lead an effort to create a new component in IBM ClearCase for a Solaris 8 security lockdown
- Assisted the team by analyzing vulnerabilities on UNIX and Linux systems

positions.title: Business Application Security Analyst (Internship)
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a Visual Basic program to automatically merge security credentials into Websphere Portal's XML configuration file based on data in Excel spreadsheets
- Voted 2nd place among my peers in the intern S.P.E.A.K. (public speaking) program

positions.title: Software Engineer (Internship)
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented front and back end for e-mail deliverability reporting system
- Expanded current reporting tools to generate reports across all server farms

positions.title: Universal Agent, Level II (Tech Support)
positions.description:
- Assisted customers via phone to troubleshoot internet connectivity problems and utilize ISP features such as web hosting, mailing lists, Linux shell accounts, and e-mail forwarding
- Designed and implemented trouble ticketing software for the Network Monitoring Center

volunteerExperience.companyName: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Colorado
volunteerExperience.description:
Every student at Sheridan High School, a low-income and underserved community, has been matched with an adult mentor with a college degree to help them through high school and prepare them to succeed in college and the workforce.  This is a 4+ year volunteer commitment.

Send emails (structured by the mentor 2.0 platform) weekly and meet in person once per month during the school year.

iMentor is a nationwide program, but the freshmen class in 2015 was the first instance of this program in the state of Colorado.

http://www.biglittlecolorado.org/page/mentor-2-0
